title: HP Brand Entrance Video
dek: Styleframes in three visual directions for an HP brand entrance video.
problem: HP needed a brand entrance video. The March 2018 styleframe presentation set out three possible visual directions for it.
approach: Version A, Shape Reveal Dots, builds scenes from clusters of photographic dots that resolve into HP devices and on-screen messaging.
Version B, Pop Color, uses concentric rings of saturated color that open onto HP printers and the line "Driven by a singular mission."
Version C, Dynamic Reveal, uses triangular cut-outs and layered photography to reveal people, devices and the HP mark.
leadership: Directed the creative for the styleframe presentation, setting out and presenting three alternative directions for the video.
